results.name: points_on_minimal_targets_when_word_is_universal
results.description: Total points allocated to 1-feature duplicate targets in informative scenes where the heard word is true of all objects and competitors have multiple features.

results.name: points_on_singleton_competitor_with_duplicate_targets
results.description: Mean points allocated to a 2-feature singleton competitor in informative scenes where the heard word is also true of duplicate 1-feature minimal targets.

results.name: scalar_implicature_points_on_full_feature_competitor
results.description: Mean points allocated to the 3-feature competitor object in informative scalar implicature scenes where the heard word is shared between a 1-feature target and a 3-feature competitor.

results.name: duplicate_targets_minus_singleton_competitor_points
results.description: Total points on duplicate 2-feature targets minus points on a 3-feature singleton competitor in informative scenes where the heard word is true of all three.

results.name: prior_points_partial_minus_full_feature_singleton
results.description: Mean point difference between partial-feature singletons and full-feature singletons in prior trials containing empty duplicate distractors.

results.name: points_on_minimal_singleton_with_duplicate_competitors
results.description: Mean points allocated to a 1-feature minimal singleton in informative scenes where the heard word is true of all objects and competitors are multi-feature duplicates.

results.name: prior_points_empty_object_with_partial_duplicates
results.description: Mean points allocated to the zero-feature empty object in prior trials containing duplicate 1-feature objects and a 2-feature singleton.

results.name: prior_points_on_empty_singleton_with_full_duplicates
results.description: Mean points allocated to the empty zero-feature singleton object in prior trials where all other objects are identical full-feature duplicates.
